english.title: Possess apparatus / article for making false identity documents with intent - Identity Cards Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with the intention that you or another would make a false identity document and that the document would be used by somebody for establishing, ascertaining or verifying registrable facts about a person, had in your possession or under your control apparatus, articles or material, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted for the making of false identity documents
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(3), (4) and (6) of the Identity Cards Act 2006.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the current legislation, please see the Identity Documents Act 2010.
